title: DOM-docx – HTML to native, editable Word docs (MIT)
claim: Show HN: DOM-docx – HTML to native, editable Word docs (MIT)
why_good: Converts HTML into native, editable Word docs (MIT-licensed) — solves a genuinely painful, common need (clean HTML to .docx).
value: A library that could anchor a paid API/service for apps generating Word docs at scale; usage-based.
risk: docx generation is crowded (many libs); winning means best fidelity + support, and the core is open/free.
